result.summary: Several visual/layout problems: a missing restaurant image with broken placeholder, truncated restaurant names, and incomplete category chips that cut off at the screen edge.

issues.description: The 'Popular right now' card for Tokumaru Ramen Bar shows a broken/empty image placeholder (gray box with mountain icon) instead of a food photo.
issues.suggestion: Load the correct restaurant image or provide a proper fallback image so the card does not appear broken.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated with the end cut off in the Fastest near you row.
issues.suggestion: Allow wrapping, reduce font size, or use ellipsis with full name on a second line / detail view so names are fully readable.

issues.description: Category filter chips (Healthy and beyond) are clipped at the right edge with no clear affordance that the row scrolls.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal scroll padding/fade or ensure the last visible chip is not hard-clipped so users know more categories exist.

issues.description: Large empty gray area above the Tokumaru Ramen Bar title makes the Popular section look incomplete or broken compared to the illustrated cards above.
issues.suggestion: Reserve consistent card image height and always show imagery (or a branded empty state) to keep section rhythm consistent.
